semantic_partitions.rule: train/validation/test partitions are frozen BY SEMANTIC PROPERTY of target classes (polynomial degree bands, monomial-support patterns, coefficient structure), then enumerated with per-member normal-form digests at build time; seeds select instances WITHIN a partition, never the partition boundary
semantic_partitions.difficulty_axis: target difficulty is held FIXED across checkpoints; varying difficulty is a separate declared axis and never confounds the developmental trend
semantic_partitions.protected_set: the fresh-obligation evaluation set is disjoint from every developmental stream by construction and sha-bound before any arm runs

cycle: 1 solve actual developmental tasks; retain success AND failure traces with typed failure reasons
2 generate candidate reusable transformations using existing registered operators first (fragment mining / macro admission per g2-macro-operator-v1)
3 test each candidate on ACQUIRING a fresh validation target, never on replaying or compressing training solutions
4 admit useful state with complete HDI-14 cost ledger, scopes, evidence supports; correctness authority and performance estimates stay separate
5 checkpoint the actual runtime state to disk

6 OS-PROCESS RESTART: the runtime process exits and a FRESH interpreter/process loads the persisted state (a function call in one long-lived process does NOT satisfy this step; the runner must evidence pid change / interpreter restart)

7 the restarted runtime acquires a protected fresh target requiring target-specific information (fresh exact observations; independently checked target equivalence); a concrete candidate object is emitted and verified by the external checker

8 the acquired target-specific object is evaluated on fresh obligations it did not train on; developmental state updates only from permitted development/validation streams, never from the protected assay
lifecycle_runner.checker_C: external to the runtime under test (the frozen polynomial identity checker, invoked as an independent unit with its own digest); internal replay never counts

checkpoint_clones: LIBRARY_ONLY: accumulated solved objects present, learning/search-control state frozen
CONTINUED: persistent native learner and all admitted state
CONTINUED_WITH_LEARNING_STATE_REMOVED: solved content preserved, the proposed developmental carrier revoked/transplanted
ORDINARY_ADAPTIVE_PARENT: same allowed history, persistence and legal adaptation machinery, outside OCM-specific bookkeeping
KNOWN_STRUCTURE_ORACLE: calibration arm only; information advantage explicitly declared; never a headline comparator
arms.joint_carrier_rule: where library and search-control state are inseparable, the runner reports the JOINT carrier and designs a compatible transplant instead of claiming surgical independence; interactions are tested by a staged factorial, not assumed into one field
arms.parent_parity: parity receipt emitted per run; parity reattributes the OCM-specific claim (M3) and never negates the mechanism claim (M1)

endpoint_and_stats.primary: B(M,T,q): actual acquisition work under the full cost ledger until the external checker establishes competence q on fresh target T, PAIRED across checkpoint clones at matched budgets
endpoint_and_stats.curves: success-probability-versus-budget; failed and censored attempts retained; refusal-rate reported per arm (cheap refusal never presents as cheaper learning)
endpoint_and_stats.trend: no per-checkpoint monotonicity requirement; estimated expected trend with uncertainty on the frozen evaluation ecology; retention and adaptation-after-shift both reported
endpoint_and_stats.stats: paired treatment-effect intervals at frozen confidence with lineage/ecology clustering, Holm multiplicity, margins pre-registered (20% registered default; change only by documented pre-execution amendment); non-overlap of separate intervals never substitutes for a paired interval

repeated_development.transitions: at least THREE chronological checkpoints; the second and third transitions must consume newly acquired material, distinguishing one useful acquisition from repeated development
repeated_development.carrier_causality: losing the effect under carrier removal AND recovering it under a compatible transplant supports causal attribution; a learned prior influencing behavior with zero retrieval calls passes (no-retrieval rule)
